= Overview =
The Community Mod Framework (CMF) is a shared mod framework for Europa Universalis 5 that provides a set of features mods can use to integrate with the game without conflicting with each other.

The framework is designed to be invisible when no dependent mods are active.

CMF is available on the [https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3605358788 Steam Workshop].

= Components =

== Community Mod Menu (CMM) ==
[[File:CMM_Example_Mod.png|thumb|300px|The Community Mod Menu.]]

The [[Community Mod Menu]] is a shared in-game settings UI that allows multiple mods to hook into a single menu through a registration API. It supports toggles, sliders, dropdowns, buttons, text inputs, and settings lists.

See the [[Community Mod Menu|CMM page]] for a quick reference, or the [https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki GitHub wiki] for full documentation.

== CMF Features ==
CMF provides several standalone features beyond the mod menu:

* '''[[Community Mod Framework Features|Custom Alerts]]''' — Dynamic, dismissable notifications in the in-game alert bar.
* '''[[Community Mod Framework Features|Action Bar Elements]]''' — Custom buttons in the game's action bar.
* '''[[Community Mod Framework Features|is_host Trigger]]''' — Trigger to check if the current country is controlled by the host player.

See the [[Community Mod Framework Features|CMF Features page]] for a quick reference.

== Community Mod Toolkit (CMT) ==
The [[Community Mod Toolkit]] is a companion set of development tools for EU5 mod authors. It provides a structured mod template and automation tools that work together through shared configuration:

* '''CMM Visual Editor''' — Browser-based interface for designing CMM settings without manual coding.
* '''Upload Tool''' — Automated Steam Workshop deployment with submod support.
* '''Translation Tool''' — Automated localization via DeepL or Gemini AI for all EU5-supported languages.

See the [[Community Mod Toolkit|CMT page]] for details.
